about: The falsifier: an extension nobody measured, stood in for by the code that asked for it. At epoch 183 bound's lock named the family a source is written in write; the published place 0.2.0 lists leaf in its own wire, so the measure refused in wordOf, and extensionOf returned the code digest without a word. Every fold kept from then on was keyed by an identity no measure recorded, and every edit refolded everything.
The same era read in bound's word instead of the place's: region/state globbed write/** only, so 0.2.0's written leaves, named leaf/, went unread and its readme lost its Pointers section.

cases.name: store/source=write, 0.2.0 declares leaf, the measure refuses
